    import collections

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    while t > 0:
        n = int(input[index])
        m = int(input[index + 1])
        index += 2
        friendships = collections.defaultdict(set)
        for _ in range(m):
            a = int(input[index])
            b = int(input[index + 1])
            index += 2
            friendships[a].add(b)
        found = False
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if found:
                break
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                if j not in friendships[i]:
                    jury = {i}
                    contestants = {j}
                    valid = True
                    for k in range(1, n + 1):
                        if k != i and k not in jury:
                            if j not in friendships[k]:
                                jury.add(k)
                            elif k not in contestants:
                                contestants.add(k)
                    if len(jury) + len(contestants) == n and len(jury) >= 1 and len(contestants) >= 1:
                        found = True
                        results.append("Yes")
                        results.append(f"{len(jury)} {len(contestants)}")
                        results.append(" ".join(map(str, sorted(jury))))
                        results.append(" ".join(map(str, sorted(contestants))))
                        break
        if not found:
            results.append("No")
        t -= 1
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
